# Spiral Docs — for consumer agents

> **Consumer agents start here.** This index is for installing and using published `@aviala-design/spiral` in product apps. Do not follow developer-kit monorepo / Figma / changeset workflows unless the task is explicitly to contribute to the library.

## Minimal use path

```tsx
import "@aviala-design/spiral/styles.css";
import { ThemeProvider, Button } from "@aviala-design/spiral";
```

No consumer Tailwind. Full English twin: [CONSUMER.md](https://github.com/AvialaOSS/developer-kit/blob/main/CONSUMER.md). Skill: [spiral-consume](https://github.com/AvialaOSS/developer-kit/blob/main/skills/spiral-consume/SKILL.md).

## Start guides (human Chinese docs)

- [介绍](https://www.aviala.top/docs/start/introduction)
- [安装](https://www.aviala.top/docs/start/installation) — keep in sync with CONSUMER.md
- [主题](https://www.aviala.top/docs/start/theme)
- [国际化](https://www.aviala.top/docs/start/locale)
- [更新记录](https://www.aviala.top/docs/start/changelog)

## Machine data (npm)

- `@aviala-design/spiral/component-catalog.json` — slim component list (import path, ThemeProvider hint)
- `@aviala-design/spiral/props.json` — prop docs
- `@aviala-design/spiral/styles.css` — single stylesheet

## Form entry

Import `Form` / `FormField` from `@aviala-design/spiral/form` and install peer `react-hook-form` (`>=7.50`).

## Contribute / maintain the library

Maintainer agents only: [developer-kit AGENTS.md](https://github.com/AvialaOSS/developer-kit/blob/main/AGENTS.md). Site stub: [贡献](https://www.aviala.top/docs/start/contribute).
